          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80

          title: Telephone number

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9\s()-]*$'

          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

      title: Owner

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

    ProblemDetail:

      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri

        title:
          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          format: int32

          maximum: 600
